title: Witch's Apparatus
description: A simple resource pack that bewitches your weapons and tools.
body:
It's me, prop, your family-friendly witch. Today, I am here to present my debut as a texture texturer.

This resource pack changes your familiar Minecraft tools to witchcraft equipment, from wands to altars. Here's a comprehensive look at your new toolkit:
- Your bow turns into a wand that summons arrows.
- Your sword is now a dagger to be used in rituals.
- Your trident becomes a broom that you can fly with.
- Your hoe becomes a sickle to harvest herbs.
- The Totem of Undying becomes a tea cup.
- A new texture for the enchanting table.
- As well as new particles for critical hits, enchanted hits, harming/healing potions, and sword sweeps.
